title: Haaye Beemaar Chale
body:
Haaye bimaar chale
Haaye bimaar chale x2
Pao mei zanjir liye
Nange sar Hayder-e-karar ki jagir liye
<<DIVIDER>>
1 Naa liya dharti ne khoo Aur na falaq ne chaaha
Mal liya chehre pe khoo
Haatho me beshir liye
2 Raat ko khaab mei
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ko tadapte dekha
Aa gaya qasade
Sugra wohi taabir liye
3 Dekhkar toota Alam
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaadare sar se sarki
Sue darya hai nazar
Aankho me hai teer liye
4 Khaab me doolhe ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbal me sajaya Najafi
Jaa rahi qabr me
Dulhan ko bhi takdir liye
